description_en: Queries one or more classic network type instances that are connected to a virtual private cloud (VPC)
description_zh: 查询一台或多台与专有网络VPC建立了连接的经典网络类型实例
kebab_example: aliyun ecs describe-classic-link-instances --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --vpc-id vpc-bp1vwnn14rqpyiczj0000 --instance-id i-bp1a5zr3u7nq9cxh0000 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeClassicLinkInstances

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 实例所属的地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The VPC ID. The target VPC must have the enable ClassicLink feature turned on. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/65413.html
parameters.help_zh: VPC ID。目标VPC必须已开启ClassicLink功能，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/65413.html。
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en: The instance IDs. You can specify up to 100 instance IDs, separated by commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID。最多指定100台实例ID，并使用半角逗号（,）隔开。
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The page number. Minimum value: 1.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
当前页码。起始值：1

默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page for paging queries. Settings: 1 to 100.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时设置的每页行数。取值范围：1~100

默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

PageNumber.description_en: The page number in the paging query

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page in the paging query
